diagnosis.rootFinding: The original generation regression was dominated by a single low-throughput prompt. Subsequent inspection found three CPU-resident Ollama models concurrently loaded, making CPU/memory contention a credible confounder.

repair.policy: lossless exclusive target residency; unload sibling Ollama models; keep target resident

conclusion: Exclusive residency repaired the mean end-to-end regression and nearly eliminated the mean generation regression while retaining large load/prefill gains. A generation-tail outlier remains, so the next dependency is CPU scheduling/contention control rather than model load/residency.
nextGate: Instrument CPU scheduling/utilization per inference and test bounded thread/concurrency policies while preserving exclusive residency.
